The **Ambuflex-skema** (Ambuflex questionnaire) is a specific clinical document and tool utilized in the management of atrial fibrillation in Denmark. It functions as the foundational instrument for individualized patient education within the [[atrieflimren-klinik|Atrieflimren-klinik]] [^src1]. Prior to their clinical appointments, patients are tasked with filling out this questionnaire at home [^src1]. 

The implementation of the Ambuflex-skema highlights a systematic, patient-centered approach to healthcare within the broader quality development framework for treating atrial fibrillation in Denmark [^src1]. By leveraging the patient's self-reported data from the questionnaire, the clinic tailors its educational efforts to the individual's specific needs and baseline understanding. This structured patient education model, notably illustrated by the interdisciplinary clinic at Hospitalsenhed Midt, supports the overarching goals of the national atrial fibrillation registry (AFDK) to ensure uniform, evidence-based, and highly personalized care for a frequent and potentially serious chronic heart condition [^src1].
